verdict.rationale: Metorial is open-source (FSL-1.1-ALv2 core, Apache-2.0 catalog) and exposes a documented REST/OpenAPI API plus session/trace logs, which gives a technical path to pull your own data out and self-host instead of being locked in, and a community comment notes it is 'fully open source (not just the client)'. However there is no explicit documentation of a data-export feature, standard open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV dump), or account-deletion/data-portability guarantees. Missing for 10: dedicated export/download feature docs, explicit data-portability statement, evidence of exporting sessions/configs/skills in a portable format.
